patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I was chopping onions and the knife slipped. It's a clean cut on my finger, bled a lot but stopped with pressure. I can still bend it fine and feel everything.
presentation.triageNote: 38-year-old male with a clean 1.5 cm volar finger laceration from a kitchen knife, bleeding controlled, with intact flexion and distal sensation.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 4 is appropriate because this stable uncomplicated finger laceration is expected to require one resource for wound repair.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has a small clean finger laceration with controlled bleeding and intact tendon and nerve function.
clinical.acuityReason: The wound needs irrigation and closure, but there is no uncontrolled hemorrhage, tendon injury, sensory deficit, or contamination concern.
teachingPoints: Tendon movement and distal sensation should be documented before local anesthetic and closure.
The wound should be explored for depth, contamination, and foreign material.

possibleDiagnoses: Partial tendon injury if examination changes
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: After irrigation and closure, tetanus status and wound precautions would be addressed before discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, holding gauze wrapped around one finger
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 38-year-old man in a casual shirt, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: holding a gauze-wrapped finger up. Expression: calm and a little sheepish. Clearly visible: gauze wrapped around one finger. No text, no logos.
